verdict.rationale: Poly is a SaaS file and agent platform, so shipping official SDKs is a fair question, but the evidence pack never mentions any client library or SDK. The documented developer surfaces are a CLI, a hosted MCP server, a Claude Code plugin and an agent skill, none of which is an SDK. Probes also found no OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths returned 404), so there is no evidence of an official SDK to build against.
